linux.post_install:
unpack() { if unzip -tq "$1" > /dev/null 2>&1; then unzip -oq "$1"; else tar -xf "$1"; fi rm -f "$1" } curl -fL --retry 3 -o gse-download "https://linuxgsm.download/SourceFortsClassic/sfc-1.0-rc7-fix-linux-i386-linuxgsm-20261102.tar.xz" unpack gse-download
# steamclient.so for the Steam API (LinuxGSM fix_steamcmd.sh does the same). for bits in 64 32; do lib="$(find . "$HOME/.steam" "$HOME/.local/share/Steam" -maxdepth 4 -path "*linux$bits/steamclient.so" 2> /dev/null | head -n 1)" if [ -z "$lib" ]; then lib="$(find "$HOME" -maxdepth 5 -path "*steamcmd/linux$bits/steamclient.so" 2> /dev/null | head -n 1)"; fi if [ -n "$lib" ]; then mkdir -p "$HOME/.steam/sdk$bits" ln -sf "$(readlink -f "$lib")" "$HOME/.steam/sdk$bits/steamclient.so" fi done
[ -e bin/datacache.so ] || ln -s datacache_srv.so bin/datacache.so [ -e bin/dedicated.so ] || ln -s dedicated_srv.so bin/dedicated.so [ -e bin/engine.so ] || ln -s engine_srv.so bin/engine.so [ -e bin/materialsystem.so ] || ln -s materialsystem_srv.so bin/materialsystem.so [ -e bin/replay.so ] || ln -s replay_srv.so bin/replay.so [ -e bin/scenefilecache.so ] || ln -s scenefilecache_srv.so bin/scenefilecache.so [ -e bin/shaderapiempty.so ] || ln -s shaderapiempty_srv.so bin/shaderapiempty.so [ -e bin/soundemittersystem.so ] || ln -s soundemittersystem_srv.so bin/soundemittersystem.so [ -e bin/studiorender.so ] || ln -s studiorender_srv.so bin/studiorender.so [ -e bin/vphysics.so ] || ln -s vphysics_srv.so bin/vphysics.so
